metaDescription: Order custom unisex pedometers for your wellness program. Perfect for step challenges and employee fitness incentives.
introHtml: Unisex pedometers offer a versatile solution for corporate wellness programs, step challenges, and employee fitness incentives. Designed for both men and women, these step counters feature simple clip-on or lanyard attachments that work with any attire. Customize them with your company logo or wellness message using screen printing or laser engraving to keep your brand visible during every walk, run, or daily commute. Whether you are equipping a safety team or launching a company-wide health initiative, unisex pedometers provide reliable step tracking without gender-specific styling.
heroAltText: Custom unisex pedometers with step display and clip, branded for corporate wellness programs
